snippet.title: Prospera | gamescom Trailer 2026 (World Premiere Announcement)
snippet.description:
⚙️World Premiere Announcement ⚙️

From humble beginnings to intricate factories: Build and manage a growing metropolis in an open world striving for prosperity, while satisfying the needs of the population. All in immersive first person or third person perspective. 

City building in an open world enters a new era and puts you right in the center of the industrial revolution like never before. Gone are the times of isometric viewpoints of classic city builders. Once you taste the immersion of building houses, laying train tracks, or decorating a sprawling settlement in full first-person view or from a third-person perspective, you will not want to go back. Orchestrate the workforce, watch the locals go about their daily life and attend to their ever-changing needs as your city lives and breathes around you.  

⚙️ Wishlist Prospera on Steam: https://bit.ly/Wishlist-Prospera

#Prospera #citybuilder #immersive #wishlist #wishlistnow #worldpremiere #industrialrevolution #automationgame #steamage #victorian

Named after the mystic “Toplitz Lake” which is situated in a dense mountain forest high up in the Alps, Toplitz Productions was founded with the aim of developing and publishing computer and video games “with heart and soul”.
